plan.notes: Source: official St. Bonaventure University 2024-2025 Undergraduate Catalog (catalog.sbu.edu, the newest officially published catalog archive; 2025-2026 exists only as an unpublished courseleaf preview), 'Computer Science, BS' program page, transcribed term-by-term from the catalog PDF's printed four-year sequence (including its semester totals: 16/16, 16/16, 15-16/14, 13/14). Transcription method: downloaded official PDF, pdftotext -layout extraction, verified against the catalog HTML text index; course titles for BONA-101, ENG-101, ENG-102 confirmed from the catalog's own transfer/admissions tables ('Intro to St. Bonaventure', 'Writing I', 'Writing II'). Degree name honesty: the catalog's official program title is 'Computer Science, BS' (Bachelor of Science in Computer Science). No substitution. Credit honesty: the catalog prints 'Total Credits 120-121' because one CS elective is 3-4 credits; it is recorded here as 3 so the sequence sums to exactly 120, matching the catalog's declared degree minimum of 120. DS-351 Data Science Case Studies is listed without a lab in the requirements table but is a 4-credit course per the 12-credit CS-track arithmetic. Catalog footnote carried here, not as a prereq: 'CSL-101 must be taken if student has no prior programming experience' (placement, not a plan course). The catalog sequence publishes no course prerequisites, so all prereq lists are empty; external_prereqs is empty. The catalog advises: 'Changes in the sequence of the program listed above may be desirable. These must be made in consultation with the student's academic adviser.'

courses.title: Computer Science Elective
courses.choice_note: Official sequence: Computer Science Elective, printed as 3-4 cr; recorded as 3 so the sequence sums to the catalog's 120-credit total. Footnote: electives must be computer science courses numbered 240-380; five electives strongly recommended; one may be from another department with adviser + chair approval.

courses.title: CS Track Course (Track 1 of 3)
courses.choice_note: Official 2024-2025 sequence: select one of three 12-credit CS tracks and take all three track courses from the SAME track. Software Design & Development: CS-244 App Development, CS-257 User Experience Design, CS-390 Software Engineering (each 4 cr incl. lab). Network & Systems Administration: CS-254 Computer Networks, CS-255 Server Management, CS-346 Operating Systems (each 4 cr incl. lab). Artificial Intelligence: CS-258 Machine Learning, CS-341 AI and Robotics (each 4 cr incl. lab), DS-351 Data Science Case Studies.
